correctness.rationale: The joint law, moment formulas, strict sign and synchronization asymptotics hold. Independently, for a reset-free leg let H be the first hit of zero and W the piecewise occupation penalty. The contribution from absorption first is g(a)=E_a exp(-integral_0^H (r+W)dt); the reset-first contribution is h(a)=r E_a integral_0^H exp(-integral_0^t (r+W)ds)dt. Renewal gives F=g(a)/(1-h(a)). With C=cosh(mu a), S=sinh(mu a), K=C+(nu/mu)S, matching the killed diffusion solutions gives g(a)=1/K and h(a)=[r(C-1)/(r+q)+(nu/mu)Sr/(r+p)]/K. Thus F^{-1} is exactly (1), including p or q zero. Occupation at the single reset point has zero duration, and each trial has success probability exp(-z); the reset-first exponential moment is continuous at zero and strictly less than one there, while the success-first moment is bounded for tilts below r. This justifies the moments. For dimensionless alpha=p/r and beta=q/r the first derivatives of F^{-1} at zero are sinh z and cosh z-1; the Hessian entries are -sinh z, (z cosh z-sinh z)/2, and z sinh z-2(cosh z-1). Applying the Hessian of -log(F^{-1}) yields (2); the covariance coefficient (4^n-n-1)/(2n+1)! is positive for n>=1. Substitution into the normalized variance of the difference gives (3). In (1) normalized Laplace arguments are O(e^{-z}) and mu a=z+O(ze^{-z}), so the limit is 1/(1+s+t). The limiting pair is positive on the diagonal and the mean ratio tends to one, giving convergence of U/tau to 1/2 in probability. If A,B are the two normalized variances and M is the defect, 1-corr=[M-(sqrt(A)-sqrt(B))^2]/(2 sqrt(AB)); A,B=1+O((1+z)e^{-z}), M~4e^{-z}, proving (5). Replay uses the displayed renewal and derivative identities. The frozen check.py was inspected, not executed; its numerical checks would not prove any infinite-domain or asymptotic statement. No formal proof or expert attestation is claimed.
